About Optima

A family-operated local team you can actually call

Founded in 1995 and based in Valley Cottage, NY, Optima has spent three decades helping businesses across Rockland and Bergen counties get their communications and security done right — the first time.

We started out as a reseller of NYNEX calling plans and phone service, and grew into one of the top commercial communications vendors in the area. Today we design and install everything from Verkada camera systems and access control to structured cabling, Wi-Fi, and business phone systems — all under one roof.

We're one of the few vendors in the region focused specifically on small & mid-size businesses, non-profits, and state, local & education communities — the customers bigger vendors overlook. Our management team and installation crews carry over 250 years of combined experience, and we back every job with white-glove service from the first site walk to a 10-year equipment warranty.

AI-powered surveillance

Cameras that think, so you don't have to scrub footage

Every Verkada camera runs advanced on-device AI — analyzing what it sees in real time so you find what matters in seconds, not hours.

People & vehicle search

Find anyone in seconds

Search across every camera by a person's clothing color, or a vehicle's make, model, and license plate — no scrubbing timelines.

Face & license plate recognition

Get alerted to who's on-site

Real-time alerts when a flagged person or vehicle appears — plus automated visitor and employee logs.

Motion & anomaly detection

Only see what matters

Smart motion filtering ignores background noise like wind or shadows, so alerts you actually get are worth reading.
